name: Parker Hannifin
description: Parker Hannifin makes the parts that make things move and flow: hydraulic, pneumatic and electromechanical motion control, filtration, seals, fluid connectors, sensors and thermal products. The larger Diversified Industrial segment sells to equipment makers (original equipment) and, through independent distributors, to the replacement market for trucks, factories, construction machines, refrigeration and energy; the Aerospace Systems segment supplies systems and components for commercial and defense aircraft and engines, earning original-equipment sales on new programs and follow-on repair and replacement business. Sales are spread across hundreds of thousands of part numbers, none above 1 percent of sales. Filtration Group (bought 2026-08-13 for $9.25B) and CIRCOR Aerospace (pending) are not in the FY2026 figures below.

employees.note: Approximately 59,850 team members, of whom about 30,830 at foreign subsidiaries.

businessLines.name: Diversified Industrial
businessLines.how: Sells hundreds of thousands of motion, flow and fluid-control parts: custom and standard products to equipment makers (one-time with design-in) and replacement parts through independent distributors (recurring aftermarket). Verticals: aerospace and defense, in-plant and industrial, transportation, off-highway, energy, HVAC and refrigeration.

businessLines.name: Aerospace Systems
businessLines.how: Sells flight-control, fuel, hydraulic, engine and thermal systems to aircraft and engine makers for new programs (original equipment) and then earns repair, overhaul and replacement-part revenue over the aircraft life; also defense programs. Split between original equipment and aftermarket is not given in the 10-K.

brands.name: Filtration Group Corporation (FGC)
brands.note: Acquired from Madison Industries for $9.25 billion cash, completed 2026-08-13 (after year end, not in FY2026 revenue); filtration for life sciences, HVAC and refrigeration and industrial. Will add to Diversified Industrial.

brands.name: Curtis Instruments, Inc.
brands.note: Acquired 2025-09-18 for about $1.0 billion net of cash acquired; in FY2026 results.

whatsNext.when: announced 2026-05-21; close not dated in the 10-K
whatsNext.text: Pending acquisition of CIRCOR Aerospace (flight-critical motion and flow control for commercial and defense aircraft) for about $2.55 billion cash; definitive agreement announced 2026-05-21
Integration of Filtration Group, financed with new $5.25 billion 364-day and $2.50 billion three-year delayed-draw term loans dated from 2026-08-13
